cover_letter_text:
Hi Cement Australia team,

I'm Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to start out as a laboratory technician testing construction materials. Your Darra lab tests cement and concrete, and your advert says you train people from the ground up, so I wanted to apply.

In the diploma I studied soil testing standards (AS 1289). In the Philippines I did site inspections and quality checks, kept material records and wrote progress reports. These days I work at a bp service station in Melbourne.

I'd move to Brisbane for the job and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Based in Brisbane, we are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic individual to join our Central Laboratory in Darra as a Trainee Laboratory Technician. ABC Training & Consulting will provide the formal certification through a combination of theory-based learning and practical onsite assessments, giving you the opportunity to develop both your technical knowledge and hands-on skills.
Your Opportunity
Our laboratory performs testing for the construction industry, providing critical technical support across our cement, concrete and related products.
- Carry out routine testing of cement, concrete and related products
- Learn and perform manual testing methods
- Develop skills in chemical analysis
- Learn how to operate, calibrate and maintain laboratory equipment
- Conduct analysis as part of investigations
- Interpret data and develop your technical problem-solving skills
- Maintain high standards of laboratory housekeeping
What You’ll Bring
- A willingness and commitment to complete a Certificate IV in Laboratory Techniques
- A genuine interest in laboratory work, science, testing or the construction industry
- The ability to follow procedures and work safely
- Good problem-solving and analytical skills
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Initiative and accountability in your work
Previous experience in a laboratory, manufacturing, construction, mining or other industrial environment will be advantageous but is not essential.
Why Join Cement Australia?
- Employee Referral Program: Be rewarded for referring someone to work with Cement Australia ($$$)!
- Our EAP allows you and your immediate family members to access confidential counselling services. Our EAP includes Legal Referral Service, Financial Wellbeing Coaching & Diet and Nutritional Coaching.
- Drive your dream car for less through our Novated Leasing partnership with sgfleet, offering fantastic discounts on vehicles.
- Renovating? DIY’er? Save on your home improvement projects with exclusive discounts on concrete and quarry products.
- Private Health Insurance Offers: Great offers on Medibank Corporate Health Cover, including discounted health insurance.
Who We Are
Cement Australia is the nation’s leading supplier of cementitious products and services, with operations in every state and territory, including expanded manufacturing and distribution in Western Australia. We’re more than cement, too: our operations span heavy industrial manufacturing, mining, bulk transport, rail and shipping logistics, and waste management through Geocycle.
We give our people the tools, support and opportunities to make a real impact. Join a collaborative team that values work-life balance and innovation, and helps build a safer, more sustainable future.
What happens next?
- Submit your application through Seek, along with your resume.
- Our recruitment team will go through every application, and we’ll contact shortlisted candidates for an initial phone screen.
- If successful after the phone screen, you will be invited to a face-to-face or Teams interview with the hiring leader/s. It’s a chance for you to ask us questions too.
- If you’re our preferred candidate, we’ll complete reference checks, a pre-employment medical and background checks.
- If everything lines up, we’ll make you an offer and confirm your start date.
If you would like to know more about Cement Australia or this role, find out more by visiting our website https://www.cementaustralia.com.au/ or emailing our Recruitment team at careers@cemaust.com.au.
